title: This baby shark stole Captain America's shield
description: Jeff's snow day ends with him swiping Cap's shield, then he charms a whole tulip field.
hook_note: A tiny shark biting Captain America's iconic shield is an absurd image that demands explanation.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Jeff the Land Shark, and today the little menace discovers snow.

segments.text: This is Jeff the Land Shark, and today the little menace discovers snow.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Everyone's sledding down the hill, and the little guy is determined to keep up.

shots.speaker: narrator
